questions: Should the CSV include a header row, and if so, what column names?
How should nested elements with the same tag be merged? Should their texts be concatenated with a delimiter, or should only one be kept?
Should attributes be included in the CSV output, and if so, how should they be formatted?
What CSV dialect (e.g., quoting, delimiter) should be used? Should special characters in text be escaped?
Should the order of rows in the CSV match the order of elements in the XML document (e.g., depth-first traversal), or some other order?
How should empty or whitespace-only text nodes be handled? Should they be treated as empty strings or preserved?
Should the root element itself be included in the CSV, or only its descendants?
If an element has both text and child elements, should the text appear in the CSV, and if so, how?
